offline.title: Offline
offline.body: You are offline. Saved court days and briefs remain available once synced.

banner.offline: You are offline. Showing what was saved on this device.
banner.stale: Saved {time}. This may be out of date.

sync.label: Sync status
sync.pending: {count, plural, one {# change waiting to sync} other {# changes waiting to sync}}
sync.detailsFailed: These changes stay on this device until they sync. Try again, or keep the local copy.

courtDay.savedFor: Court day for {date} is saved on this device
courtDay.unavailable: This court day was not saved. Connect to load it.

brief.unavailable: This brief was not saved. Connect to load it.

storage.title: Offline storage
storage.days: {count, plural, one {# court day saved} other {# court days saved}}
storage.cleared: Saved data removed from this device
storage.unsupported: This browser cannot save data for offline use.
storage.empty: Nothing is saved on this device yet
storage.full: This device is out of space. Clear saved data to make room.
storage.denied: This browser has blocked offline storage. Allow site data in the browser settings to read court days without a connection.
storage.optedOut: Offline saving is turned off on this device.
storage.clearFailed: Saved data could not be removed. Try again.

privacy.title: What is kept on this device
privacy.body: Court days and briefs for the next few days are kept encrypted on this device so you can read them without a connection. They are removed when you sign out or switch workspace.
privacy.lostPhone: If you lose this device, signing out from another device does not erase it. Use the device lock, and clear saved data before you hand a device over.
privacy.clearConfirm: Remove all saved court days and briefs from this device?

errors.decrypt: Saved data could not be read. Connect to load it again.
errors.quota: There is not enough space on this device to save more.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong with offline storage.
